# The Odds API

> > Real-time and historical sports betting odds API providing bookmaker data across global sports leagues with JSON endpoints for developers.

The Odds API delivers comprehensive betting odds data from major bookmakers including FanDuel, covering moneyline, spreads, totals, and player props. The API supports integration with Excel, Google Sheets, and custom applications through JSON endpoints for live and historical odds across dozens of sports.

## Major League Sports Odds APIs

- [NBA Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/nba-odds.html): NBA odds API with moneyline, spreads, totals & player props data
- [EPL Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/epl-odds.html): English Premier League odds API with 1X2, handicap & player props data

## Regional & International Sports Odds

- [AFL Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/afl-odds.html): AFL odds API for Australian football with live & historical bookmaker data
- [Tennis Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/tennis-odds.html): Tennis odds API for Grand Slams, ATP & WTA tournaments match winner data

## College & Niche Sports Odds

- [NCAA Lacrosse Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/ncaa-lacrosse-odds.html): NCAA lacrosse odds API covering moneyline, spreads & totals
- [UFL Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/sports/ufl-odds.html): United Football League odds API with moneyline, spreads & totals
